title: Early Lactate Clearance Rate in Sepsis
brief_summary: To assess the Influence of early lactate clearance rate monitoring in patients with sepsis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients whose blood lactate level reached or exceeded 2.0 mEq / L

Exclusion Criteria:

* Incomplete clinical data
study_population: Patients with severe sepsis or septic shock were recruited from Emergency ICU of the second hospital of Hebei Medical University.
